title: parahebe muelleri
intro: Parahebe muelleri, commonly known as the New Zealand spinach or parrot's beak, is a perennial herb native to New Zealand and Australia. The health benefits of Parahebe muelleri include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Parahebe muelleri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
